_about: Rule 2 frame operators. Every organization that operates, convenes or publishes a frame used in this study enters the candidate pool BY CONSTRUCTION, independent of whether it appears in any frame's listings. Operators are screened on C1-C5 and coded on the full instrument like any other record, are flagged frame_operator = TRUE, and are EXCLUDED from every within-block rate and from the saturation count, because their inclusion is guaranteed rather than sampled.

undecided.name: DataKind
undecided.for: Listed as an operator in workbook sheet 3; ran the 2019 Google.org AI Impact Challenge jointly, so it touches a frame in use.
undecided.against: Its own frame was rejected as not enumerable.
undecided.reason: OUT. The one case with a real argument on the other side: DataKind co-ran the 2019 AI Impact Challenge with Google.org, and that cohort IS one of the four GORG cohorts enumerated here, so it had a claim to operating a frame in use. Resolved to OUT by the lead reviewer, treating DataKind on the same terms as any other organization. It may well enter through FF or MCGV, and a record admitted that way counts toward within-block rates and saturation, which an operator record does not.

_status: CLOSED 2026-09-16, before any frame was captured, any snapshot taken, or any organization enumerated. Nine operators enter by construction (see `settled`). All six contested entries are OUT (see `undecided`, retained with their reasoning rather than deleted, so the decision is auditable). The registered test is whether an organization operates a frame USED in this study; none of the six does.
_not_exclusion_from_the_study: Removal from this list is not exclusion from the study. Each of the six enters the candidate pool on the same terms as any other organization if one of the eight frames surfaces it. A record admitted that way is analytically stronger than an operator record: operator records are excluded from every within-block rate and from the saturation count, because their inclusion is guaranteed rather than sampled, while a sampled record counts toward both.
_codebook_conformed: Consequential edit applied in protocol v5 on the same date: originating_frame in codebook sheet 4 drops NAPIT, KNIGHT and SCHM — no frame of those names is in the register and, with this list closed, no record can carry them — and gains OPERATOR and PROBE.
